scope: Classic Normal only; additive desktop ranking model preserving the production correction and cooperation guard. No X16 compression or production promotion in this trial.
data: Use full-history roots only for fitting; preserve original whole family/seed grouped split. Recover native scores, runtime guard and teacher values from retained corrections. Stability diagnostic resamples two independent eight-world batches on 32 outcome-blind development roots.

learner.objective: within-position pairwise logistic ranking of teacher preferences on top of production scores; equal total weight per root
learner.tuning: One fixed fit, no held-out hyperparameter selection or refitting after tournaments. Production is the zero-delta baseline.

offline_gate: Proceed only if held-out mean internal teacher score regret is lower than production after the actual cooperation guard. Report grouped uncertainty, stability and all-root metrics; teacher agreement is not game strength. Stop if teacher repeatability shows no useful repeatable preference beyond production.

tournament.primary: Matched candidate-minus-production league score with 95% complete opponent-and-side block bootstrap interval; positive lower bound supports improvement on this distribution, interval crossing zero is inconclusive.
tournament.secondary: Direct production head-to-head; no requirement to defeat the teacher. Fixed cohort, no extension after inspecting outcomes.
tournament.time_cap: If diagnostics or runtime consume the budget, stop at a recorded partial stage. Never silently reduce the fixed cohort and call it full validation.
